decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal, because of its position, size, scale and appearance, is acceptable and would not harm the surrounding Conservation area or neighbours' living conditions. The proposal therefore meets adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the intent of the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No. 25 Algar Road, and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office).
description: Demolition of existing shed and the erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a shed to rear garden of house.
